title: A guard fails when an offered theme lacks any of its four parts (Space, Spotlight, Website, Email)

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Survey EVERY theme and make sure they have their full design system and all 4 parts, with all templates. Spotlight, Space, Website and Email templates." "Every theme should have a full, standardized design system."

detail: With Bold and Wildheart's Spotlight layouts (LIVE-2357) and kit emails (LIVE-2359) shipped, every theme a picker offers has all four parts. lib/themes/four-parts.test.ts keeps it that way: for each id in SITE_THEMES it requires a Space surface (MEGA_SURFACES), six whole-page Spotlight looks (spaceLooksFor), a `<theme>-general` website starter kit in the theme's own editor theme, and at least four kit emails in the stock catalog. A theme offered without one of them, or one that loses a part, fails CI. Mindless stays out of the pickers (RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS) until its pictures land, so it is not yet held to the guard.
